en: A vintage postcard showing a wide, tree-lined avenue with horse-drawn carriages, early automobiles, and a double-decker bus on a cobblestone street. There are classical statues on pedestals flanking the street, columns topped with lamps, and the Arc de Triomphe visible in the distance. The text at the top reads '832. PARIS - L'Avenue des Champs-Élysées' along with 'C. M.' on the right.
